tasks.description: The login flow should be defined to ensure a smooth user experience. This includes determining the authentication method and user session management. The definition should be detailed enough to guide the implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid username and password, when the user attempts to log in, then they are successfully authenticated and redirected to the portal dashboard.

tasks.description: A list of report types that will be available in the customer portal needs to be compiled. This includes determining the data sources for each report and the frequency of report generation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of available reports, when the user navigates to the reports section, then they can view and select from the list of available reports.

tasks.description: The notification settings for the customer portal need to be defined. This includes determining the types of notifications, notification channels, and user preferences for notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's notification preferences, when an event triggers a notification, then the user receives the notification according to their preferences.

tasks.description: A background section for the customer portal document needs to be written. This should provide context and an overview of the portal's purpose and goals.
acceptance_criteria: Given the document, when the background section is read, then it provides a clear understanding of the portal's context and purpose.

tasks.description: Acceptance criteria for the customer portal need to be defined. This includes determining the test cases and validation rules for each feature.
acceptance_criteria: Given a feature, when the acceptance criteria are applied, then the feature meets the defined requirements.
